text:
alex: Heads up — multiple hostedapi customers reporting 502/504s from edge between 15:03–15:09 UTC. Spike starts right after billing-service deploy at ~15:01. Seeing traces: https://traces.redwood/infer/trace/abc123

mira: same here. NGINX logs show repeated 'upstream prematurely closed connection' and 'failed to read response header from upstream'. Sample log below:

```
[15:04:12] nginx: 502 while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.2.3.4, server: hostedapi, request: "POST /v1/generate"
[15:04:12] upstream: "http://127.0.0.1:8080/", host: "billing.internal"
```

samir: repro I ran locally: fire 200 concurrent /embeddings requests with a large X-User-Meta header (~8KB). Keepalive pool exhausted and nginx returned 502s under load. Curl sample to repro:

```
curl -v -H "X-User-Meta: $(python -c 'print("a"*8000)')" -X POST https://hostedapi.redwood/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

jess: did anything change around header-size or proxy config in the last deploy?

mira: billing-service added X-Tenant-Cost header at 15:01 which can include long customer tags; also switched to chunked responses for streaming summary at the same time.

ops-bot: deploy/billing-service/production succeeded (jira-1234) @ 2025-11-15T15:01:22Z

alex: working hypothesis: very long headers + chunked resp cause upstream handoff churn. NGINX worker threads queue, keepalive sockets churn, pool exhaustion -> 502/504s under concurrency. Need conn pool metrics on edge and auth-proxy.

evan: grabbing metrics now — auth-proxy active connections spiked to 102/100 around 15:04; keepalive queue latency shot up.

samir: noticed some responses toggled Connection: close which prevents socket reuse and amplifies churn.

mira: temporary mitigation options: 1) strip/truncate long tenant header at edge, 2) rollback billing header change, 3) tune nginx buffers/proxy settings.

alex: quick mitigation: add nginx map to drop or truncate X-Tenant-Cost for /v1/ endpoints, set proxy_http_version 1.1 and ensure proxy_set_header Connection "" to preserve keepalive, and raise proxy_buffers slightly.

jess: will patch edge nginx with map and reload. @samir can you add a server-side truncation for X-Tenant-Cost to 512 bytes?

samir: will open a quick PR to truncate header in billing-service before sending to auth-proxy; canary within 20–30m.

ingress-bot: deploy/edge-nginx/drop-tenant-header rolled to canary @ 15:25, promoted to prod @ 15:32

mira: after the nginx map + billing truncation, 502 rate fell back to baseline within ~3 minutes. Customers A and B confirmed recovery.

alex: follow-ups (tickets): 1) add e2e regression test that includes large headers; 2) alert when keepalive pool > 80%; 3) add header-length lint in billing-service CI.

jess: created PROT-789 (header lint) and PROT-790 (e2e with large headers). Linking traces/logs: https://traces.redwood/infer/trace/abc123 and https://logs.redwood/nginx/edge/1776654321

samir: PR: https://git.redwood/billing/PR/452 (truncation)

evan: monitoring continues, will keep watch for 24h.

alex: thanks all — great triage. :thumbsup:
